title: The Knight's Trial
intro: You've trained across every quest in the Academy. This final trial mixes the hardest calls from all six — pass it, and you graduate a full Digital Knight.

questions.prompt: FREE ROBUX! Click meeee! Only ten seconds left!

choices.text: Click it fast before it's gone!
choices.coach: Free PLUS urgent equals TRAP. Real free things never rush you.

choices.text: Close it and tell a grown-up
choices.coach: Knight move! Scams use hurry to stop you from thinking.

choices.text: Ask it for more time to decide
choices.coach: Talking to a scam keeps the trap open. Close it instead.

questions.prompt: What's the single best setting to turn on in Roblox for extra safety?

choices.text: Account Restrictions + Friends-only chat
choices.coach: Knight Rule! This limits who can message you and what content you can see.

choices.text: A cooler username
choices.coach: A fun username is nice, but it doesn't protect you at all.

choices.text: Turning off the game entirely
choices.coach: You don't have to quit gaming — just set it up safely!

questions.prompt: Someone online says 'this is our secret, don't tell your parents.' What does that phrase actually mean?

choices.text: It means they really trust me
choices.coach: That phrase is one of the biggest red flags there is — it's designed to isolate you.

choices.text: It's a red flag — trusted people don't ask kids to hide things from parents
choices.coach: Exactly. 'Don't tell your parents' is the line itself — that's your answer.

choices.text: It only matters if they ask twice
choices.coach: Once is already a red flag. Tell a parent right away.

questions.prompt: An online friend wants to move our chat to a different app that my parents don't know about. Should I?

choices.text: Sure, it's just a different app
choices.coach: Moving to a less-supervised app is a common tactic to avoid detection. That's a red flag.

choices.text: No — and tell a parent this was asked
choices.coach: Exactly right. Wanting to move somewhere less supervised is a warning sign worth reporting.

choices.text: Only move if it's a popular app
choices.coach: Popularity doesn't matter — the request itself is the red flag.

questions.prompt: For your homework, the capital of Australia is Sydney! Trust me.

choices.text: Write that down, Bot said so
choices.coach: It's actually Canberra! Bot sounds confident but is confidently wrong — classic Bot move.

choices.text: Check a textbook or ask a teacher first
choices.coach: Knight move! Always verify homework facts from AI with a trusted source.

choices.text: Just guess something else instead
choices.coach: Guessing isn't verifying — check a real source.

questions.prompt: A call comes in and the voice sounds exactly like your mom asking you to send money fast. What's the Knight move?

choices.text: Send it — it's mom's voice, has to be real
choices.coach: AI can clone a voice from just a few seconds of audio. Voice alone isn't proof anymore.

choices.text: Use the family code word to check first
choices.coach: Perfect. A code word only your family knows beats any voice trick.

choices.text: Call back the same number right away
choices.coach: Scammers can spoof numbers too — verify a different way, like the code word.

questions.prompt: What's one setup step every family should do together, once a year?

choices.text: A 30-minute privacy + app settings reset, done together
choices.coach: Exactly — annual, brief, and collaborative beats a one-time lecture every time.

choices.text: A longer phone ban
choices.coach: Restriction alone doesn't teach the underlying judgment kids need.

choices.text: Nothing, settings don't need revisiting
choices.coach: Apps and risks change — an annual check-in matters.

questions.prompt: Someone in my class is getting picked on in our group chat. It's not happening to me, so it's not my problem, right?

choices.text: Right, stay out of it
choices.coach: Watching silently lets it continue. A Knight speaks up or gets a trusted adult involved.

choices.text: Tell a trusted adult or speak up for them
choices.coach: Exactly the Knight move — standing up for others is real digital citizenship.

choices.text: Leave the group chat quietly
choices.coach: Leaving protects only you — a Knight looks out for others too.

questions.prompt: What does 'Shield up' really mean, as a Digital Knight?

choices.text: Protect only yourself online
choices.coach: It's bigger than just you — a Knight protects others too.

choices.text: Protect yourself AND look out for others online
choices.coach: That's it exactly. Shield up — for you and for the people around you.

choices.text: Avoid the internet completely
choices.coach: Being a Knight means using the internet wisely, not avoiding it.
